steps.domain_action: Initialize the void state before the braid begins
Establish the self-model of the braid structure
Fork the active bit into T and F arms
Deposit constructive truth on the T-arm
Deposit constructive falsity on the F-arm
Rejoin the arms into the Belnap FOUR state
Compose the braid segment with the next operation
Advance the transformation toward the boundary
Reverse the transformation to decode the braid
Re-inscribe the self-model after the cycle
Anchor the closed boundary of the scale-collapse topology
